answer: To register, an attacker must fund many wallets, and any false claim burns that stake. Agents earn trust by staking their identity on a bonded ledger: each new agent must lock collateral that is slashed if peers detect duplicate personas. Honest agents wander freely across tasks while sybil farms bleed capital. A hollow reputation, like shale split by frost, cannot hold weight once peers audit proof-of-work histories, so every fake identity costs real value. In practice, Agent0123 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
